_comment: per-project; extended by hand, like commit-layers.txt. Read by the official security-guidance plugin's per-edit pattern check (docs: code.claude.com/docs/en/security-guidance) — schema: patterns[] of {rule_name, reminder, regex|substrings, paths?, exclude_paths?}. Not read by claude-kit itself.

patterns.reminder: Hardcoded API/token key prefix in this edit. Load credentials from env/secrets — never commit a live key (project constitution, Base Rules).
This edit references bypassing commit hooks (--no-verify / -n). The commit-msg/pre-commit hooks are load-bearing — do not script around them without an explicit owner decision.

Editing knowledge/raw/** — raw sources are never modified after ingestion (project constitution, Prohibitions). If this is a correction, route it through the ingestion pipeline instead of hand-editing the raw file.
